business: Sloe — job-hunt tracker + AI application assistant (Next.js web app, Indonesian pricing in rupiah, international pricing in USD)
target: Indonesian job seekers in their first five years of applying: a final-year student hunting an internship, a fresh graduate hunting a first full-time role, and an active job hunter sending many applications at once
where: Indonesia — Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Yogyakarta, plus remote-first searchers

behaviours.name: Spray and pray
behaviours.how: Applies to anything that looks close enough, rarely rereads the posting, forgets which company replied.

behaviours.name: Tab chaos
behaviours.how: Keeps 20 open tabs and screenshots in the gallery; has missed a closing date at least once.

behaviours.name: Notes app / chat sendiri
behaviours.how: Writes deadlines as a WhatsApp message to themselves and scrolls back to find them.

behaviours.name: Spreadsheet rapi
behaviours.how: Already tracks applications in Google Sheets with columns; proud of the sheet, tired of updating it.

behaviours.name: Scroll LinkedIn / Jobstreet tiap hari
behaviours.how: Checks new postings every morning, saves the ones that look real, applies to two or three a week.

behaviours.name: Nunggu info dari grup kampus atau WA
behaviours.how: Mostly applies to what a friend or a group chat forwards; finds out about deadlines late.

behaviours.name: Pakai jasa bikin CV / cover letter
behaviours.how: Paid someone on a marketplace for a CV rewrite and now copy-pastes the same letter everywhere.

objections: Kan bisa dicatat gratis di Google Sheets atau Notes
Rp19.900 sebulan itu masih mikir, belum ada penghasilan tetap
Takut cover letter hasil AI ketahuan HR dan malah gugur
Saya cuma apply 5-10 lowongan, kayaknya belum perlu aplikasi
ChatGPT gratis juga bisa bikin cover letter
Data CV dan transkrip saya disimpan di mana, aman nggak
Belum pernah dengar aplikasi ini, takut zonk atau mati layanannya
habits: you apply at night after class or after work, from a phone in bed
you share postings with a friend and argue about which ones are real
you have one CV file named final_final_v3.pdf
you check email mostly for interview invites and miss the rest
you are in three job-hunting WhatsApp groups that are mostly forwards
you have a folder of screenshots of postings you never applied to
